title: Adjacent-degree differential compatibility for normalized Hom maps
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-ring-hom-extension-differential, the supplied normalized maps commute with the Hom differentials in adjacent degrees.

proof.text: Use the chosen Hom-complex projections and their product universal property. On the bottom topology, the sheafification unit is an isomorphism, so tensor induction reduces equality of extension maps to transported pure tensors. Naturality of the sheafification unit and the supplied formula for F.map show that F.map sends pure(b,x) to pure(b,a(x)). Apply the Hom differential projection formula and evaluate on pure tensors in both variables. The supplied normalization identifies the postcomposition and signed precomposition terms; the additive pure-tensor map preserves subtraction and integer scalar multiplication. Tensor induction and internal-Hom extensionality prove the adjacent chain identity. All private helper lemmas are proved in this module. The private canonical-coordinate presentation extends the named projections to arbitrary equal target indices by equality transport; its product and differential laws are proved coordinatewise from homComplex_projections_exists. Evaluation carries projection data only, keeping the large chosen specification folded during specialization.

theorem ringHomExtension_differential_adjacent
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    (F : RingSiteModules A ⥤ RingSiteModules B)
    (h : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringSiteMap φ) M)
    (_hm : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), F.map f = eqToHom (h M) ≫
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom (ringSiteMap φ) M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm)
    (hF : F.Additive) (P Q : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ)
    (t : ∀ n : ℤ,
      F.obj ((homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).X n) ⟶
        (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf B)
          ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj P) ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj Q)).X n)
    (n : ℤ) (ht : ∀ (n p : ℤ) (U : (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})ᵒᵖ) (b c : B)
      (f : (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q).X n |>.val.obj U)
      (x : (P.X p).val.obj U),
      ringHomEvaluate ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj P)
        ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj Q) n p U
        ((t n).val.app U (ringExtensionPure φ F h _ U b f))
        (ringExtensionPure φ F h (P.X p) U c x) =
      ringExtensionPure φ F h (Q.X (p + n)) U (b * c)
        (ringHomEvaluate P Q n p U f x)) :
    t n ≫ (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf B)
        ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj P) ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj Q)).d n (n + 1) =
      ((ringExtensionComplex F hF).obj
        (homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q)).d n (n + 1) ≫ t (n + 1)
